How it works
Message Prizmi
Send a message through a messaging app. Just tell Prizmi what you need.
It works on your devices
Prizmi carries out the task on your connected computers — or answers directly from the cloud.
You stay in control
Approve actions before they run. Enable or disable any skill. Your data, your rules.
Built with your privacy in mind
Your data is encrypted
Your information is encrypted and kept private. We never sell it, and we never use it to train AI.
End-to-end when it matters
Mark anything Prizmi does on your computer as sensitive, and its result is encrypted end-to-end. Only your device can open it. Not even Prizmi can see your data.
You are always in control
You decide what Prizmi can do and what it can reach. Prizmi does the work for you, but it never clicks Submit, Pay, or Send. You make the final call.
Your information is encrypted and used only to help you. You're always in control, and you can delete your account and personal data anytime.
Learn more →
Your inbox, handled
Prizmi checks your email every day, identifies the messages that need a reply, and drafts responses in
your
style. You just review and send.
Set it up once and never fall behind on email again.
Care for your loved ones, effortlessly
Tell Prizmi to remind your mom to take her medications every day. Send good-morning messages to your family. Send or Receive a funny joke every day to brighten your and your loved ones' day.
Stay connected with the people who matter, without the mental load.
Your coding companion, across devices
Spot a puzzle or coding question on your work computer? Send Prizmi a message and get the answer on any device. Set up quick command shortcuts to capture your screen, solve a problem, or explain an error, from anywhere.
Your devices work together so you don't have to switch between them.
The web, handled for you
Prizmi can use your browser just like you would, filling out forms, navigating websites, and getting everything ready. Just tell it what you need, and you make the final call.
No more wrestling with clunky websites or tedious forms.
Your files, organized
Ask Prizmi to sort your downloads, find that document you saved last week, or clean up your desktop. It works on any of your connected computers: Linux, Windows, or macOS.
Spend less time searching and more time doing.
And so much more
From weather updates to calendar management, from web research to to-do lists, from stock prices to daily jokes, Prizmi handles hundreds of tasks across all your devices.
You are only limited by your imagination.
Ready to let Prizmi handle the busy work?
